heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: How do you start a custom software project?
items.answer: With a discovery workshop to define goals, users and scope, followed by a plan and estimate.

items.question: Can you modernize my legacy system?
items.answer: Yes. We can migrate in stages so your operations keep running.

items.question: Who owns the source code?
items.answer: You do. The code and documentation are handed over to you.

items.question: How long does software development take?
items.answer: A focused system can go live in 8 to 12 weeks, while larger multi-department platforms take 4 to 9 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
